author: Facti0n
body: So recently I made a map called "Battle of Stonehenge." It isn't done yet so I'm not saying I want it in rotations yet, but when I do finish it, how do I get it in rotations?
body_tagged: So recently I made a map called "Battle of Stonehenge." It isn't done yet so I'm not saying I want it in rotations yet, but when I do finish it, how do I get it in rotations?
title: How do you get one of your maps into rotation

replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body:
When you finish creating a map, you can submit it to the Map Releases subforum. (https://avicus.net/forums/categories/43) 
Maps also need XML in order to work, you can try making your own or asking a Map Developer for help. To look at how documentation works for XML, refer to https://docs.avicus.net

The Map Developers then review your map, and decide on whether or not it gets loaded to the server's map repository. After additional testing, it may be added to the rotations if its gameplay is up to the standards
